abilities.desc_en: Well Timed Blocks against Light and Heavy Ranged Attacks activate the Parry Shield, Reflecting those attacks at {{var_1}} of their original damage.

abilities.desc_zh:

abilities.desc_en:
Damage Control
Jetfire’s state-of-the-art awesome Repair System diverts reserve energy to mend damaged components and suppress any active fires.
Blocking
While Jetfire is under {{var_9}} Health, his Repair System is Online. While the Repair System is Online, Holding Block for {{var_10}} consumes an Energy Charge to Purify a Burn Debuff and Repair {{var_11}} of Health over {{var_12}}.

abilities.desc_en:
Absorption Shield
Blaster’s Shielding system can be upgraded to absorb incoming energy attacks and repair damage. A similar upgrade was requested by his fellow Autobots for their audio receptors as an answer to his taste in music.
While Shielded: Blaster’s Shield allows him to shrug off the impact of Basic Energy Ranged Attacks and reduces a further {{var_13}} of incoming Energy Damage. Additionally Energy Attacks that hit Blaster while his Shielding is up have a {{var_14}} chance to instantly Repair Blaster for {{var_15}} of the opponent’s Attack Rating. If the attack is a Special Attack he repairs double that amount instead.
+ about {{var_16}} per level

abilities.desc_zh: 如果这次特殊技消耗5个或更多能量充能，则最后一击命中时100%概率触发修复阻止，阻止对方所有回血能力，持续15秒
abilities.desc_en: If the opponent reaches zero Power as a result of this Power Burn, the strength of their Power Gain Buffs is reduced by {{var_12}} for the rest of the fight.
